sequencing.exact_last_duplicate: repeat identical cached reply, never repeat action
sequencing.new_sequence: only next expected sequence; supported or error reply consumes a valid next sequence
sequencing.invalid_frame: may return INVALID without advancing sequence
sequencing.client_retry: never automatically repeat a state-changing request after timeout/disconnect
sequencing.status_handshake: STATUS must return DONE/REMOTE and required capabilities before any button request

lifecycle.authorization: Local on-device toggle; RAM-only, default off after reboot/SYSTEMOFF; remote keys cannot grant permission
lifecycle.physical_buttons: always active; local input cancels outstanding remote actions/handoff
lifecycle.remote_input: One logical SHORT perTAP or centerLONG perBACK; no pressed-key state or repeats
lifecycle.handoff: OPEN_FILE REQUESTED/TRANSITION acknowledges only the request; client disconnects. Device opens file application only after actual GAP disconnect and foreground cleanup. User explicitly connects separate file client; version handshake confirms file mode.
lifecycle.sleep: Existing user standby remains; no SYSTEMOFF wake and no periodic keepalive requirement
lifecycle.conflicts: NFC write/failure or active RF, another BLE owner, transition or unavailable UI may reject operation
lifecycle.transport: Exclusive Remote NUS mode; no file protocol dispatch inRemote. Characteristic writeWithResponse plus separate matched notification required.
lifecycle.overflow: Multiple different concurrent requests or exhausted bounded transport queue abort session; no input replay.
lifecycle.same_link_handoff: Only when capability16 is advertised: OPEN_FILE_SAME_LINK returns DONE/FILE after the NUS file parser is ready on the same connection. Transfer exclusive client ownership without unsubscribe/disconnect. A new version handshake confirms the running application. Legacy OPEN_FILE remains unchanged.

vectors.name: duplicate_left
vectors.context: Repeat exact most recent left request before sending next sequence; repeat cached reply only.

vectors.name: wrapped_status
vectors.context: Expected sequence wraps from65535 to1; not a replay of an earlier session.

limits: No encryption/pairing claimed; enabling local remote exposes button control to a nearby connected client until disabled or sleep.
Requested handoff is not proof filetransfer is ready.
Not compatible with upstream fire-and-forget button protocol; feature adapted for DE firmware with explicit ownership.
